sources.title: Metairie woman pleads guilty to death, dismemberment of Jaren Lockhart

sources.title: No appeal for New Orleans murderer
sources.description: Reports that the Louisiana Supreme Court declined Speaks’s request for review, leaving the appellate decision standing.
sources.limit: The underlying action sheet and exact ruling date were not obtained in this review. October 17 is the publication date, not an independently verified order date.

timeline.title: Jaren Lockhart is killed
timeline.text: The district attorney identifies June 6 as the date of her death.

timeline.title: Grand jury indictment
timeline.text: Speaks and Sanchez are indicted in Jefferson Parish.

timeline.title: Speaks pleads not guilty
timeline.text: The appellate history records his arraignment and plea.

timeline.title: The original page’s stated update date
timeline.text: This is the date displayed in the preserved page, not an independently established publication timestamp.

timeline.title: Separate trials
timeline.text: The State severs the defendants for trial.

timeline.title: Initial sentencing
timeline.text: Life for murder; 40 years for obstruction; 20 years for conspiracy.

timeline.title: Obstruction sentence enhanced
timeline.text: The original 40-year obstruction sentence is replaced with life imprisonment under the habitual-offender statute.

timeline.title: Sanchez enters guilty pleas
timeline.text: Manslaughter and two obstruction-related offenses; concurrent sentences of 40, 40 and 20 years.

timeline.title: Supreme Court review denial reported
timeline.text: WXXV reports that the Louisiana Supreme Court declined review. This is the report date; the underlying order was not obtained.
timeline.locator: Publication date; exact order date unverified

timeline.title: Repository status note added
timeline.text: A dated update explains the archive’s provenance and summarizes the earlier case outcomes.
